title: Create recipe
description: Recipes feed the shared dish library. A dish name that does not exist yet is created automatically when you save.

section.basicsHint: The dish name is matched case-insensitively against the library. Reuse an existing name so the dish is not duplicated.
section.ingredientsHint: 1–50 ingredients. Each name may appear only once.

field.name: Recipe name
field.descriptionPlaceholder: Short description shown with the dish

errors.name: Recipe name is required
errors.servings: Servings must be a whole number of at least 1
errors.duplicateIngredient: This ingredient is listed more than once
errors.time: Minutes must be a whole number of 0 or more

created.title: Recipe saved
created.note: There is no endpoint to list your recipes yet, so this is the only copy you will see. The dish itself is already available when planning meals.
